homePage.bio:
I build things that should exist: apps, systems, and occasionally RC planes. Most of what I know came from just doing it.

I've been building things on the internet. Starting with Android apps in Java/Kotlin, crashing RC planes, and figuring out how computers actually work. Currently a CS student working on software development, embedded systems, and cross-platform applications.
aboutExtended: I've been building things on the internet. Starting with Android apps in Java/Kotlin, crashing RC planes, and figuring out how computers actually work.
Currently a CS student, but most of what I know came from just doing things.
I work across the stack : Flutter, C/C++, Python, Java, web frontend, embedded systems, Linux, local LLMs.
Open to technical internships where I can actually build something.

projectsPage.title: My Projects
projectsPage.subtitle: A collection of things I've built — some polished, some still in progress.

allProjects.title: Edge-AI Autonomous Warehouse Robot Fleet
allProjects.category: Robotics · Edge AI · SIH Internal — Top 100 of 500+ Teams
allProjects.description: Decentralized coordination and collision avoidance for 3+ warehouse robots running on Raspberry Pi/Jetson Nano with no central cloud planner. Robot-to-robot location sharing, route planning, and dynamic rerouting recorded zero collisions and 20%+ faster task completion across simulated fleet runs.

allProjects.title: SentinelRAG
allProjects.description: Protects AI knowledge systems from malicious instructions hidden in retrieved documents, emails, and web content. Compares a vulnerable baseline, fine-tuned classifier, and small language model across detection accuracy, response time, and usability.

allProjects.title: AEGIS — Autonomous Drone Emergency Response
allProjects.description: A simulated multi-drone platform to detect incidents and coordinate emergency response across a city, integrating drone control, live telemetry, AI-based object detection, flight simulation, geofencing, and a real-time map dashboard.

allProjects.title: Engram for Obsidian
allProjects.description: An open-source Obsidian plugin giving an AI chat assistant persistent, auto-summarizing memory and semantic vector search over a user's notes, with support for 10+ local and cloud LLMs. Includes vault-scoping permissions, prompt-injection-safe context handling, and an undo history panel.

allProjects.title: SmartFlow — Adaptive Traffic Signal Control
allProjects.description: A closed-loop traffic controller on ESP8266 hardware with 3-lane ultrasonic vehicle sensing and OLED output, computing adaptive green-light cycles via a local LLM endpoint with a deterministic optimization fallback for uninterrupted operation.

allProjects.title: PureFuel
allProjects.description: A cross-platform nutrition and health tracker for Android and Web — built as a free, ad-free alternative to paid apps like Cronometer and HealthifyMe.

allProjects.title: Shala
allProjects.description: A mobile-first application that digitizes school administration — fees, attendance, marks, and notices. Built for low-connectivity regions with offline-first resilience.

allProjects.title: Journease - Travel Planner
allProjects.description: A smart travel companion for logging trips, memories, and getting AI-powered insights. Built for a university hackathon — placed in the top 100 teams out of 900+ in Smart India Hackathon.

allProjects.title: Lie Detector Prank App
allProjects.description: My first published Android app — built at 15, entirely self-taught, pre-AI. A prank lie detector app that crossed 17.5K organic downloads on the Play Store and is still live.

allProjects.title: Fixed-Wing RC Aircraft
allProjects.description: Designed and assembled a fixed-wing RC aircraft from scratch — FlySky TX/RX system, 2200KV brushless motor, ESC, LiPo battery, self-fabricated cardboard airframe. It flew. Then it didn't.
